moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-zoomthrough, written here): Outgoing scene on top: scale 1 -> 1.3 and opacity 1 -> 0 over 0-350 ms; the incoming scene sits underneath at full opacity, scale 0.8 -> 1 over 250-600 ms; easeInOutCubic, centre origin; 600 ms total. (The demo runs both over the whole transition, ease-in-out.) Params: duration (0.6 s) · scaleOut (1.3) · scaleIn (0.8).
